units.function: Mocked Express tests for instance settings reads/writes, environment selection, operational recovery controls, actor authorization and managed-cloud execution-mode enforcement.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Vitest -> Express instance-settings routes and auth middleware -> mocked settings/environment/heartbeat/activity services; importing middleware also initializes a filesystem logger under the user home.
units.keyDataModels: Instance settings, general privacy/UI/execution configuration, experimental feature and recovery controls, default execution environment, board/Agent actor and activity record.
units.lifecycle: Authorize actor -> validate/strip server-owned fields or preview action -> call settings/environment/recovery service -> log mutation activity -> return effective representation; cloud token presence imposes an execution-mode floor.
units.testAssessment: All 25 tests failed in the sandbox solely because logger import attempted a user-home mkdir; approved unsandboxed rerun passed 25/25. Route behavior is broad but heavily mocked and lacks full schema, concurrency, audit-content, Agent-read and sensitive-output coverage.
units.designRationale: Expose one instance configuration surface with admin-only mutation, limited member reads, operational preview before recovery and platform floors that preserve managed deployment constraints while keeping self-hosted controls writable.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs independently deployable policy/configuration APIs that separate display preferences from privacy, execution and recovery governance and bind every material change to an accountable human and stable evidence.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the admin/member split, server-owned-field stripping, reference validation, preview-before-run and same-value echo compatibility. Rebuild around typed configuration domains, stable error codes, explicit DeploymentPolicy identity/version instead of token presence, side-effect-free imports, scoped enterprise visibility, optimistic concurrency and immutable before/after receipts.
units.responsibilityConflict: A forced recovery can mutate operational state under a generic settings endpoint with only activity-call counts asserted, while instance-wide execution and privacy controls share a broad admin role. Company OS requires action-specific authority, accountable initiator, affected scope, approval where risky and result/evidence linkage.

2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: 0/25 passed; all failed on logger mkdir EPERM before assertions
units.securityFindings: HIGH deployment-policy weakness: secret-token presence is the execution policy switch, without asserted issuer/version/expiry. HIGH recovery-accountability gap: forced liveness recovery lacks action digest, approval/idempotency and evidence assertions. HIGH import side effect: route middleware creates a writable user-home log directory at import. MEDIUM authorization gaps: Agent reads and several membership/admin transitions are untested. MEDIUM audit gap: only call counts, not content or transactionality. MEDIUM error-contract gap: environment failure depends on English text. MEDIUM configuration coarseness: UI, privacy and execution controls share one broad role.
